props.name: size
props.description: The size of the picker.

props.name: class
props.description: Additional CSS class name.

props.name: label
props.description: Label for the field.

props.name: description
props.description: Description text.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error message.

props.name: contextualHelp
props.description: A ContextualHelp element to place next to the label.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text.

props.name: maxVisibleMonths
props.description: The maximum number of months to display at once in the calendar popover.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: The day that starts the week.

props.name: slot
props.description: A slot name for the component.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Callback when blurred.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Handler called when the value changes.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Callback when focused.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Callback for key down (forwarded to the field when the popover is closed).

props.name: onKeyUp
props.description: Callback for key up (forwarded to the field when the popover is closed).

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: The ID of an element that describes the date picker.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: An accessible label for the date picker.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The ID of an element that labels the date picker.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the field is disabled.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Auto focus the field.

props.name: form
props.description: The form attribute. The associated form id for the hidden date input.

props.name: name
props.description: The name attribute for form submission. The name for the hidden date input used in HTML form submission.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value (controlled).

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: Callback when focus changes.

props.name: shouldCloseOnSelect
props.description: Whether the calendar should close when a date is selected.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the overlay is open by default (uncontrolled).

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Whether the overlay is open (controlled).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when the overlay open state changes.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale to use for formatting.

props.name: validationState
props.description: Validation state.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The default value (uncontrolled).

props.name: minValue
props.description: The minimum allowed date.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: The maximum allowed date.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Whether the field is read-only.

props.name: createCalendar
props.description: Resolves a calendar system by its Unicode identifier.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Whether a date is unavailable.

props.name: pageBehavior
props.description: Page behavior for calendar. Controls whether calendar paging advances by one month or by the visible month range.

props.name: selectionAlignment
props.description: Determines how visible months align around the initial focused date.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: A function that determines whether a date is disabled.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Whether the field is required.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Whether the date picker is invalid. Whether the value is invalid (controlled).

props.name: validationBehavior
props.description: Whether HTML form validation is used. Validation behavior mode.

props.name: granularity
props.description: The granularity. The granularity of the date/time (day, hour, minute, second).

props.name: maxGranularity
props.description: The maximum granularity (largest editable unit). Defaults to `year`.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: The hour cycle. Whether to show the hour in 12 or 24 hour format.

props.name: hideTimeZone
props.description: Whether to hide the time zone.

props.name: placeholderValue
props.description: The placeholder value. The placeholder date (determines segment structure).

props.name: shouldForceLeadingZeros
props.description: Whether to force leading zeros. Whether to force leading zeroes in month/day segments.

props.name: validate
props.description: Custom validation function.

props.name: allowsNonContiguousRanges
props.description: Whether dates outside the min/max range are allowed.

props.name: buttonAriaLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the calendar trigger button.

props.name: dialogAriaLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the calendar dialog.

props.name: calendarAriaLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the calendar grid region.
